errors.text: The proposed antiferromagnetic interaction is placed primarily across the fcc/C14 interface, between C14 Ti and the adjacent fcc matrix, whereas the target mechanism concerns antiparallel coupling of Ti and Fe/Co/Ni sublattices within the magnetic electronic structures while retaining an overall ferromagnetic ground state.

The requested compositionally matched C14-dominant Fe27Co27Ni17Ti29 comparison is omitted, so the experiment cannot isolate the C14-specific transitions or assign the 1084 K and 168 K transitions to the fcc phase.

The DOS falsification criterion incorrectly treats a reduction in total DOS at the Fermi level as the required signature; the target calculation instead requires spin-polarized DOS showing unequal spin-up and spin-down contributions at the Fermi level for the fcc phase.
